settings.directory.label: Chat directory
settings.directory.description: Workspace where chat sessions are scoped and mirrored.
settings.agent.label: OpenCode agent
settings.agent.description: Primary agent ID used by the chat (default: msbos-chat).
settings.opencode_bin.label: OpenCode binary
settings.auto_pair.label: Pair automatically
settings.auto_pair.description: Runs `opencode pair` and consumes the link when there is no token or the token expired.
settings.auto_export.label: Export sessions
settings.auto_export.description: Mirrors every conversation as JSON and Markdown inside the workspace.
settings.notify_on_finish.label: Notify on finish
settings.notify_on_finish.description: Shows a notification when a response finishes while the panel is minimized.
settings.show_bar_label.label: Show title in the bar
settings.show_bar_label.description: Shows the short session title next to the icon.
settings.max_tool_output.label: Tool output limit
settings.max_tool_output.description: Maximum characters of a tool result shown in the chat and in the export.
settings.panel_size.label: Window size
settings.panel_size.description: Chat panel size preset. The plugin reloads to apply it.
settings.glyph.label: Bar icon
settings.glyph.description: Tabler glyph used by the bar widget.
